transcription: Zimuti reruva rakakura rine mapazi matete anoyerera,  uye mashizha aro akawanda maduku, akasvibira, ane ruvara rwegirini.

transcription: Pane imwe nzvimbo pane vanhu varikufamba pakati pomugwagwa. Nechekudivi kwomugwagwa uyu kurikuratidza kuti pane chitoro chirikukutengesa simbi. Nechekure parikuatidza chimwe chikwangwani chine ngura.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Miti yema banana yakadzvarwa yakaungana panzvimbo imwe chete. Mimwe midoko mimwe mihombe. Ine mashizha akareba egirini akafara anoita seakachekwa. Parutivi neche kuruboshwe kune mumwe muti unemakwande egireyi. Pasi pane uswa hwakaoma nejecha.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Dzimba dziri mukati mefenzi. Pamusoro pane setiraiti dishi ichena idiki. Kurudyi kune chirugu chehuku chakavakwa nemapuranga uye chakaiswa mapurasitiki matema pamusoro. Muti muhombe une mashizha egirini.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Panzvimbo inosangana migwagwa yetara. Pane motikari yakamira chena yakamirira kuti dzimwe dzipfuure, uye pane marara ezvi gubhu, pane sora rakawoma.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Nzvimbo iyi inoratidza kuti inzvimbo iri mudhorobha. Pane miti yakawanda inosanganisira miti mikuru nemiti midiki. Panewo zve maruva anoratidza Kuti maruva akanaka. Panewo zve motokari chena. Uye padivi pemiti iyi pane zvivakwa zvinoratidza kuti anogona kunge ari mahofisi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Musikana ari kufamba pedyo nenhandare yecricket. Musikana uyu akabata mureza achiita senge ari kuda kuusimudza. Musikana uyu akapfeka nhumbi nhema dzine mataro mitaro michena.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Pane musikana mutema akarukwa zvakareba zvebhurawuni akapfeka hembe ina mavara mavara akagara pasi.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Ndiro ine chikafu chakabikwa nenzira yepamusoro. Chikafu ichi chinosanganisira sadza rakabikwa nehupfu hwemabahwe machena rakabhakwa zvakanaka rikaita chibhora. Parutivi pane muriwo wakawanda unoratidza kuti inyama yehuku inosanganisira mitsipa nemakumbo ehuku.

transcription: Mumango mudiki urikuratidza kuti wakabereka kwazvo. Mango dziri mumuti uyu hadzisati dzaibva. Nechepasi pemumangu uyu pane matombo aripo uyezve tumwe tumango twakadonha.

creator: digital_umuganda
transcription: Chikafu chakaiswa mundiro. Chimwe chinoratidza kuti maguru emombe akabikwa zvineunyanzvi akaibva zvakanaka sezvo ane muto wakatsvukira unoratidza kuti wakaiswa madomasi nehanyanisi.
